eraseDialog.title: Erase all data on this device?
eraseDialog.intro: This deletes all people, genotypes, consents, notes and logs from this browser. Hearth keeps no copy anywhere, so there is nothing to recover afterwards.
eraseDialog.exportFirst: Export first. Save a dump to your files now; you can import it later from Settings & export to get everything back, on this device or another.
eraseDialog.attachmentsNotice: Attached documents are erased from this device too. Copies in a backup folder stay until you forget the folder and delete its files.
